_help: base_url: address of the API server without /api; empty means no server, data stored on the device. tiles_url: full address of the PMTiles archive of Kraków, read in byte ranges (tools/mock_backend/server.py serves it with make mock); empty or unreachable means the sample base map bundled in the app. 10.0.2.2 is the computer that runs the emulator.
